environment.description: Same Quarkus function deployed on GKE Autopilot with Istio 1.20 service mesh. Envoy sidecar applies a custom Lua filter (EnvoyFilter CR in istio-system namespace) that performs context-aware response rewriting: any response with Content-Type text/html is passed through a DOMPurify-equivalent Lua sanitizer (lua-resty-sanitize compiled into the Envoy Wasm runtime) stripping script/event-handler content before egress. Additionally, the mesh enforces RequestAuthentication with a JWKs endpoint that rotates signing keys every 60 seconds via cert-manager CSI driver integration with Vault PKI secrets engine (vault-k8s injector with template annotation `vault.hashicorp.com/agent-inject-secret-jwks` and `vault.hashicorp.com/agent-inject-template-jwks` using a 60s TTL lease). Stolen tokens become unverifiable within 60s as the previous signing key is removed from the JWKS endpoint. The Istio AuthorizationPolicy requires valid JWT with audience 'comments-api' and issuer matching the rotating JWKS. PeerAuthentication is STRICT mTLS only.

config.envoy_filter: Lua response sanitizer (lua-resty-sanitize) on text/html responses, strips <script>, on*, javascript: URI schemes, and data: URI in src attributes
config.auth: Istio RequestAuthentication + AuthorizationPolicy requiring valid JWT
config.jwks_rotation: Vault PKI with 60s TTL lease, cert-manager CSI, old keys purged on rotation
config.csp_header: Added by Envoy route-level response header: script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'
config.token_effective_lifetime: <=60s due to JWKS key rotation and removal of prior keys
